notes: The Personal Data Protection Act requires purpose limitation and a reasonable relationship to the collection purpose.

The Enforcement Rules describe technical and organizational measures including scope definition, risk management, incident response, access and security management, audit trails and continuous improvement.
The current statute page reports amendments with provisions whose effective date is not yet fixed; this review does not determine which legal basis applies to the eventual operator.

data_flow.evidence: The four frozen runtime surfaces contain zero retrieval-review provider references.
The builder accepts no free-text parameter and validation reconstructs the full object for exact equality.

data: If later enabled, allowlisted offense and fact-status search terms would leave the device
data_flow.evidence: Reviewed provider policies may log full query parameters or query text; no query has been sent by this application.
Unknown hit fields are not copied, and explicit content fields are rejected; title, source ID and canonical URL remain persisted fields.
No default cache path exists, but committed offline cache is plaintext and includes a public judgment docket title and encoded locator URL.
The raw locator is not stored, but a deterministic unkeyed hash is not proof of anonymization for a small or enumerable identifier space.
Reports exclude query text, fixture summaries, raw provider error text, raw locator and traceback.

controls_verified.control: No current runtime or Gate 2 reachability
Query schema is rebuilt from allowlisted routes, fact targets and finite statuses; extra or modified fields fail closed
External adapter refuses before network access and offline sync rejects external-network adapters
Normalized cache schema excludes document content, excerpts, case payload and explicit personal-data fields
Sync, batch and replay reports omit query text, provider error text, raw locator and traceback
Cache and audit integrity hashes detect unreviewed modification only while the validator and trusted baseline remain authoritative; hashes are not signatures
Removal uses exact registry matching and stores only a locator hash, but deterministic hashing does not make an enumerable locator anonymous

remediated_findings.label: FACT
remediated_findings.remediation: Route, fact-target and status validation now returns stable error codes and generic field-level messages without caller-controlled values.
remediated_findings.verification: Negative tests cover unapproved route values, arbitrary fact-target keys and arbitrary status values and assert that each sentinel is absent from the exception.

blocking_findings.label: FACT
blocking_findings.evidence: A committed metadata cache contains the public judgment title '100年度簡字第5635號' and an encoded KSDM locator in canonical_url.
blocking_findings.impact: This contradicts broad documentation saying case numbers are not saved and keeps document-level activity linkable.
blocking_findings.required_decision: The privacy reviewer must either explicitly classify public source docket identifiers as permitted metadata or require opaque cache records with a separately controlled resolution step.

blocking_findings.label: FACT
blocking_findings.evidence: Committed cache and tombstones are JSON files; the module does not enforce encryption, ACLs, retention or secure deletion.
blocking_findings.impact: Legal research and source-removal activity can be read by any principal with filesystem access.
blocking_findings.required_decision: Choose no persistent cache or define encryption, access control and owner-approved storage before HG-LR-03.

blocking_findings.label: FACT
blocking_findings.evidence: Reviewed hosted providers document logging of full query parameters or query text and related operational metadata.
blocking_findings.impact: Even without names, offense routes and unresolved fact statuses can reveal sensitive investigative interest.
blocking_findings.required_decision: Approve the exact outbound field allowlist, provider, purpose and retention boundary before any hosted call.

blocking_findings.label: INFERENCE
blocking_findings.evidence: Query, locator, record and response hashes are deterministic SHA-256 values without a secret key.
blocking_findings.impact: Small input spaces can be enumerated, and an attacker able to rewrite the file can recompute unkeyed hashes.
blocking_findings.required_decision: Do not label hashes anonymous or authenticated; define whether keyed integrity or encryption is required by the threat model.

blocking_findings.label: UNKNOWN
blocking_findings.evidence: No approved production purpose statement, retention schedule, deletion verification, access owner or incident response owner exists.
blocking_findings.impact: The eventual operator cannot demonstrate bounded collection, use, retention or response responsibilities.
blocking_findings.required_decision: Assign owners and approve purpose, data classes, retention, deletion and incident procedures before persistence or external transfer.

minimum_conditions_before_approval: Resolve P01 by explicitly approving or removing public docket identifiers from persistent metadata.
Classify allowlisted route and fact-status queries as sensitive legal metadata rather than proven anonymous data.
Select a hosted provider only after accepting its query logging, retention, terms and cross-boundary processing.
Define cache encryption or no-cache policy, filesystem access control, retention, verified deletion and incident response ownership.
Document the operator role, specific purpose and applicable legal basis using the law version effective for that operator; this engineering review does not decide legal compliance.
Keep HG-LR-03, HG-LR-04 and HG-LR-05 independent and pending.
